why: An empty slot collapses and a loaded one takes the picture's size: the text after it moves.

edits.replace: display: inline; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0; margin: 0 4px 0 0;

name: a state's flag is never asked
why: The slot waits forever and no state ever shows its flag.

why: A state whose lookup failed loops one request a repaint; a failure must wait for ⟳.

why: The last character of an ISNI is a check character and may be X.
